intro: Government, technology, and critical infrastructure sectors feature prominently across 17 ZCyberNews articles tagged cisa-kev, spanning 19 April 2026 to 2 October 2026. Coverage centres on the United States, with additional reporting on Global, North America, EU, and Europe regions. Five CVEs dominate: CVE-2026-20079 and CVE-2026-48907, each rated CVSS 10, alongside CVE-2023-49105, CVE-2025-39682, and CVE-2026-65400, all rated CVSS 9.8. The severity mix comprises 7 critical, 4 high, and 2 medium entries, reflecting federal government, enterprise, and critical infrastructure exposure.
